item.description: Pricing matrix aggregate CRUD via {{gatewayUrl}}/api/v1/pricingmatrix. Create variants: flat labor, labor tiers, material cost-range markup, and other category markup (material vs other are mutually exclusive).
item.name: PricingMatrixController

query.description: Sort direction: Asc or Desc. Default: Asc.
Free-text search across searchable fields. Optional.
Filter by active records. Default: true.
